name: comp-338
blurb: Accordion with colored icon indicators for expanded state.
description: Chevron icon changes color (not just rotation) when section is open, providing dual visual feedback.
use_when: Emphasizing open/closed state beyond rotation, strong color themes.
avoid_when: Low-contrast designs or when color alone is the only state indicator.
a11y: Chevron is aria-hidden. Color change should not be the sole state indicator.
